newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY FIXED WEAKER AT 2.46 PCT FROM PARITY RATE.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY FIXED WEAKER AT 2.46 PCT FROM PARITY RATE.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1500 to the dollar, down from 3.1420 on Wednesday and at 1.8320 to the mark, up from 1.8330, the NBP said.

The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.46 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, weaker than Wednesday's 2.48 percent fix. It was at 2.45 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes along with dollar/mark swings on world markets, against Wednesday's 2.50 percent.
